description: Remove a bed from the garden. Siltwell archives it: it leaves the bed lists in the app and in these tools, its care schedules stop, and planned plantings queued for it are skipped. Past weather history still shows its name. The app has no way to restore it. Blocked while the bed has active plantings; remove or finish those first. Identify by bed name.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

name: delete_bed
title: Archive a bed
